children: The following bids, mergers, acquisitions and disposals were reported by 2000 GMT on Thursday:
** Starbucks
has explored a takeover of Chipotle Mexican Grill
, the Financial Times reported, in a move that would reunite Chief Executive Brian Niccol with the burrito chain he led before joining the coffee giant two years ago.
** Devon Energy
will sell its Eagle Ford assets to Crescent Energy
for $4.2 billion, trimming its portfolio to sharpen focus on its core operations in the Permian Basin following the $58 billion merger with Coterra Energy.
** Drugmaker Viatris
said on Thursday it would buy Pacira BioSciences
for $1.65 billion in cash, adding two non-opioid pain treatments to its portfolio as it looks to build out higher-value branded medicines beyond its core generics business.
** Dulux paint maker AkzoNobel
and US peer Axalta Coating Systems
are set to win EU antitrust approval for their $25 billion merger with a pledge to sell AkzoNobel's vehicle refinish business to address competition concerns, people familiar with the matter said.
** Italian engineering group Trevi
said on Thursday the improved takeover price offered by larger rival Webuild
falls at the lower end of its fair valuation range. Webuild on Monday raised its cash offer to €5.165 ($5.78) from €4.50 per share.
** Brazilian delivery app iFood, owned by Dutch investment group Prosus
, is in advanced talks to buy employee benefits provider Caju, Valor Economico reported on Thursday, citing unidentified sources.

** Alliant Insurance Services has acquired Laconia, New Hampshire-based Melcher & Prescott, expanding its presence in the Northeast US, the broker said on Thursday. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
** Credit Agricole
Chief Executive Olivier Gavalda said on Thursday the French bank will not tender its 29.3% stake in Banco BPM
into Monte dei Paschi di Siena's
takeover offer.
** BAM Groep
has agreed to buy (A.Hak) in a deal valuing the privately owned underground infrastructure specialist at an enterprise value of €504 million ($565 million), the Dutch builder said.
** The holding company of Italian entrepreneur Francesco Gaetano Caltagirone said on Thursday it would vote against Monte dei Paschi di Siena's (MPS) (BPMS.MI) proposals to acquire Banco BPM
and Banca Generali

** AI-focused broker consolidator Equal Parts said on Wednesday it acquired El Valle Insurance, Archer Insurance Solutions and Loma Portal Insurance in the third quarter. Financial terms of the deals were not disclosed.
** Arthur J Gallagher's Pen Underwriting has acquired Wexford, Ireland-based Ornella Underwriting Limited, the broker said on Wednesday. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.
** Anglo American's
proposed $54 billion merger with Canada's Teck Resources
and the sale of its Brazilian nickel business have become test cases for navigating geopolitical complexities as they await antitrust approval, CEO Duncan Wanblad said on Wednesday.

** Britain's BBC and Channel 4 have held preliminary talks with the government about a broader tie-up of some operations, two people with direct knowledge of the discussions said, in a potential shake-up of the country's public broadcasters.
